personality: 7 Dark-First Utility (with 3 Editorial typography for elegant Cinzel serif headers)
personality_one_liner: A dark, ember-glowing sci-fi survival experience with elegant serif typography and high-contrast tactical utility.

spacing.rule: Use tight, utility-focused spacing for stats and upgrades, but allow the home card and arena to have breathing room. Avoid oversized padding in the Armoury list.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. Rely on solid dark surfaces, thin borders, and ember-glow textures for depth as per Dark-First Utility.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Player lobby providing a visual anchor (Muster card) and progression hub (Armoury).

states.error: Failed to load player data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Screen background must include the radial ember glow image. Top Right: Coin pill. Main content is a vertical scroll: 1. THE MUSTER card (tiny orange tracked label, large serif player name, 2x2 stat tiles with thin borders for Best Wave/Kills/Runs/Coins, stat rows for Damage/Resistance/Health, large solid orange 'ENTER THE DEEP' button, tiny 'DRAG TO MOVE' hint). 2. ARMOURY card (coin count header, vertical list of upgrade rows. Each row: Name & level in sans, muted description, and an outlined orange coin button on the right). Bottom: Outlined LEADERBOARD button.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.layout: Full screen bordered dark arena. Top Left: Red health bar (100/100) with thin cyan XP bar underneath and 'Lv 1' text. Top Right: Dark pills for WAVE, KILLS, COINS. Center: Blue player ship. Enemies are red/orange, XP gems are cyan diamonds, white bullets. Footer: Persistent hint 'DRAG TO MOVE · YOU ATTACK ON YOUR OWN'. Implement a floating virtual joystick area overlay for 'drag to move'.

screens.name: LevelUp
screens.purpose: System choice overlay when XP bar fills.
screens.layout: Arena dims heavily (dark overlay). Top centered: 'LEVEL 2' tiny orange label and 'CHOOSE A SYSTEM' in large Cinzel serif. Center: 3 stacked option cards. Each card has an orange-outlined square icon on the left, serif name and muted sans description. When pressed, the card gets a solid orange borderStrong. Needs a confirmation or auto-select upon tap.

screens.name: GameOver
screens.purpose: Post-run summary and return to Muster.
screens.layout: Dark overlay. Large serif 'HULL BREACHED'. Stats list: Wave Reached, Kills, Coins Gathered. Large orange 'RETURN TO MUSTER' button.

background_glow.alt: Dark background with orange glowing fire sparks serving as an ember radial glow

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the UI replication of 'EMBERDEEP' as requested by the user, incorporating the 'MUSTER' card and 'ARMOURY' card on the Home screen.
Use Google Font 'Cinzel' for all major headings, player names, and system titles to give it the requested elegant serif small caps look.
Use 'DM Sans' for body text, stats, and utility numbers.
The Home screen background must use the 'background_glow' image behind the UI with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim so text remains highly readable.
Gameplay screen needs an arena layout with thin `border` (#3A231A). Use the specified colors: Health=error (#FF1744), XP/Gems=success (#00E5FF), Player=info (#2979FF), Enemies=orange/red.
Buttons should follow Dark-First utility styling: sharp or sm radius, no heavy drop shadows, rely on solid orange for primary actions and orange borders for secondary actions.
